summary: OFFWORLD LEGACY is an interactive digital museum that brings the history of space exploration to life. We developed a virtual museum where visitors can explore four important space missions: Cassini, Galileo, Magellan, and NEAR Shoemaker. Through spacecraft displays, visual exhibits, and mission information, the platform allows users to discover these missions in an engaging and accessible way. Our project addresses the challenge of making space exploration knowledge easier to explore and understand by bringing different missions together in one digital experience. OFFWORLD LEGACY aims to preserve the legacy of space exploration, support education, and inspire students and future generations to learn more about the universe.
details:
OFFWORLD LEGACY is an interactive digital museum that brings the history of space exploration into a virtual environment. It features four historic missions: Cassini, Galileo, Magellan, and NEAR Shoemaker. Visitors can explore the museum, view spacecraft displays, and discover mission histories through visual exhibits and interactive 3D experiences.

The project brings different space exploration stories together in one place, making them more engaging and easier to discover. It aims to support education, encourage curiosity about space, and inspire students and space enthusiasts.

We developed the project using TypeScript, React, Next.js, Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Tailwind CSS. These technologies power the website, its interface, and its interactive 3D environment.

Our creative approach was to present space exploration as a virtual museum rather than a traditional information website. During development, we considered educational value, accessibility, visual quality, navigation, and user experience.

Our goal is to make the history of space exploration more engaging and inspire future generations to discover the universe.
